crossRefs.note: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
“Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty…
“If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself…
As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be…

translations.web: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
translations.bsb: let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
translations.kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
translations.asv: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:
